en: A black‑and‑white photograph showing several women in headscarves and long skirts sweeping a cobblestone square with long brooms. In the background stands a large masonry church or cathedral with tall arched windows and a steep roof, partially obscured by trees. A freestanding kiosk or small pavilion is visible near the church, and a distant church tower or spire rises on the left side of the image. The overall scene suggests an early‑20th‑century European town square.
